profile: graph convolutional network: A graph neural network architecture that maps or embeds graphs using shallow single-layer and vanilla layer variants. It introduces layer-wise non-linearity and biases. GCN layers can be designed and trained as part of a training and optimization pipeline. Efficient algorithms exist for training deep and large graph convolutional networks.
